items.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / annotated interface explanation. Edit the supplied existing Theme A screen into a labelled explanatory version of the SAME simple product design. Reference image 1 is the edit target. Retain its light minimal white/grey/sage visual language, core sections, hierarchy and Plant A demonstration content. Standardize the navigation to exactly Overview, Evidence, Site inspection, Assessment. No extra product modules. Expand the canvas to the right to add a clean generous annotation rail; keep the screenshot large and legible, not squeezed into a tiny thumbnail. Target a wide high-resolution landscape educational board. Add numbered circles on screen sections and matching concise numbered explanation cards in the right rail; thin leader lines must not cover text. Make section labels readable. Small header: "Theme A — labelled concept". Shared legend: BLUE "Extracted suggestion"; GREEN "Analyst input"; PURPLE "System result"; GREY "Locked original / history". These colors refer to provenance/editability, not supported/unresolved status, which stays normal green/amber. Do not paint every field or turn the screen into a rainbow. Persistent footer text verbatim: "Analyst: edits and reviews. Judge: view and download only. Permissions come from sign-in." These are design concepts of the current backend, not implemented frontend. No new permission roles, borrower editing, automatic image condition inference, risk scores, or AI certainty. Count labels use prepared trial baseline 18 claims / 15 supported / 3 unresolved, not latest live counts. Keep callout copy concise and exact enough to avoid tiny paragraphs. Source scans never directly create an accepted claim or change a status. Do not overwrite or visually edit the original certificate/photo content except making generic demonstration text readable.
PAGE 01: Inspection overview.
Add these seven numbered callouts matching existing sections:
1 "Inspection context" — "Declared site and signed-in role. Role is not user-editable." Place by Plant A selector and Role Analyst. Inspection navigation is available to both roles, but not permission escalation.
2 "Summary counts" — "SYSTEM · Read-only counts from saved findings." Place by KPI strip.
3 "Claim matrix" — "SYSTEM · Computed statuses. Click to inspect; cannot type a result." Place by matrix.
4 "Selected claim" — "SYSTEM · Evidence explanation and next action." Place by CNC-002 commissioning detail.
5 "Follow-up requests" — "ANALYST · Create, resolve or reopen; does not prove a claim." Place by outstanding requests.
6 "Recent activity" — "LOCKED · Actor, time and reason are recorded automatically." Place by activity feed.
7 "Workflow actions" — "ANALYST · Reconcile. BOTH ROLES · View evidence and report." Place by buttons.
Do not depict a role dropdown that changes permissions; role is a read-only signed-in badge. No matrix field is directly editable.

PAGE 02: Evidence workspace.
Add these seven numbered callouts matching existing sections:
1 "Evidence library" — "ANALYST · Upload and classify files. JUDGE · View only."
2 "Original scan" — "LOCKED · Original PDF/photo stays unchanged."
3 "Extracted fields" — "SCAN → SUGGESTION · Readable text supplies candidate serial/model/reference/amount. ANALYST corrects and confirms." This certificate screen's actual fields serial/model/site/commissioned are textual certificate contents. Mark serial/model/site/commissioned fields editable by analyst after extraction; not automatically accepted.
4 "Quality flags" — "ANALYST · Review blur, unreadable or duplicate-ID warnings."
5 "Claim linking" — "ANALYST · Choose machine, atomic claim and relation." No auto linking implied.
6 "Confirm and save" — "ANALYST ONLY · Confirm data, link evidence, then reconcile." Keep commissioning Unresolved before acceptance.
7 "Provenance + history" — "Source/capture time: entered at upload, then locked. Receipt time, digest and audit: system locked." IMPORTANT visually add lock icons and disabled appearance to Source and Capture time fields in the displayed existing evidence form. They are not editable after upload. History remains read-only.
Small note "OCR reads text; it does not verify the certificate." Do not imply the photo itself proves commissioning.

PAGE 03: Site inspection.
Add these seven numbered callouts matching existing sections:
1 "Machine + mission" — "SYSTEM · Checklist from the declared machine and evidence gaps."
2 "Photo evidence" — "ANALYST · Upload a new photo; original bytes stay locked." Rename the original "Replace photo" button to "Add new photo"; do not imply overwriting an original. Use JPG/PNG max 12 MiB, not previous 10MB placeholder.
3 "Observed identifiers" — "ANALYST · Verify serial/model/site against the photo or plate. OCR may suggest readable text; no auto-confirm."
4 "Condition + installation" — "ANALYST INPUT · Operating, packaged and installation status are human observations, not image AI." Keep Packaged, Present, Unknown installation selected.
5 "Source + capture time" — "ANALYST · Enter source and time before saving. Management is context only." Put by source/time fields.
6 "Notes + claim links" — "ANALYST · Write observations and select relevant claims."
7 "Findings + next step" — "SYSTEM · Unresolved findings and clarification request; not editable here." Put by keyitems/nextstep right panel.

Keep every numbered annotation, body explanation, form value, visual layout, footer and all other text unchanged.
